title: tiangong_service_key_records.v1 — verifier-only Beidou service key record
description: Canonical verifier record schema for Beidou-to-Tiangong service keys (Todo 20, Beidou plan). This file documents the schema and field names ONLY, with redacted examples. Actual verifier values are NEVER stored in source control — they live only in the runtime DB table `tiangong_service_keys`. The server pepper (TIANGONG_SERVICE_KEY_PEPPER) is a deployment secret (env/vault); the plaintext token is shown to the operator exactly once at issuance and never persisted anywhere.

key_id.description: Public key identifier: "tgsk_<base64url(16 random bytes)>". The only identifier a caller presents, via the X-TG-Service-Key-ID header.
key_id.example: tgsk_<key_id: public identifier, 22-char base64url suffix; not committed>

verifier.description: Full 32-byte HMAC-SHA-256(server_pepper, token), hex. NOT HMAC(token, server_pepper). Stored only in the Tiangong DB; comparison uses crypto.timingSafeEqual. The plaintext token is never stored.

key_prefix.description: One-way-redacted 6-byte prefix of the token (base64url, 8 chars). Used for audit/operator identification only; cannot reconstruct the token.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 issuance timestamp. The token is shown to the operator exactly once at this moment and can never be retrieved again.

rotation_window_end.description: For a rotated key: end of the key-overlap retention window (= max callback retry window). The previous key remains valid until this instant, then is revoked.
rotation_window_end.example: <rotation_window_end: ISO-8601 timestamp or null; not committed>

revoked_at.description: Revocation invalidates the key_id immediately; the verifier row is retained (marked revoked), never deleted.
revoked_at.example: <revoked_at: ISO-8601 timestamp or null; not committed>

version.description: Monotonic key version; rotation issues version+1.

bindingNotes: Directional keyring (frozen): this Beidou-to-Tiangong service key (verifier lives only in the Tiangong DB; holder is the Beidou caller) is independent from the Tiangong-to-Beidou callback HMAC keyring (deployment-injected on both sides; consumed by Todo 22).
The DB row additionally binds the principal: origin_system (fixed 'beidou'), workspace_slug, project_slug, scopes (least-privilege allowlist; no wildcard scope).
Every auth decision is audit-logged (service_key_audit_log) with key_id, originSystem and a one-way-redacted token prefix only.
